title: Multicore Environment State Representation for Agent-Directed Test Generation
problem: Verification of multicore systems requires testing core interactions, but current test generation lacks an effective method to extract actionable state information from raw environment observations for learning-based optimization.
motivation: Automated test generation for multicore verification is crucial for design quality; reinforcement learning agents need rich, interpretable state representations to discover high-coverage test suites efficiently.
method: A reinforcement learning approach where an RL agent generates test programs executed in a multicore simulation environment (16 and 32-core ARMv8 with MOESI coherence). The agent learns from interaction how to improve verification coverage by recovering structured state information from raw environment observations.
key_novelty: Effective state representation extraction from raw multicore observations to enable RL agents to learn directed test generation strategies for coherence and multi-core interaction verification.
contributions: Novel RL-based directed test generation for multicore systems
State representation methodology for extracting actionable information from raw observations
Evaluation on 16 and 32-core ARMv8 MOESI designs
Demonstrated scalability across different core counts

metrics.other: Verification coverage improvement (specific metrics not provided)

limitations: Not discussed in abstract; specific coverage metrics and baselines not detailed.
